annotation.title_clean: France 2030 : une nouvelle ambition en matière d'intelligence artificielle
annotation.title_en: France 2030: A New Ambition for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Gouvernement français (Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances, Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche, Secrétariat général pour l'investissement)
annotation.venue: Digital Skills and Jobs Platform (European Commission)
annotation.summary_en: Second phase (2021-2025) of France's national AI strategy within France 2030, committing €2.22bn (€1.5bn public) to AI training, research, embedded/frugal/trustworthy AI and AI diffusion in the economy. Robotics and autonomous vehicles appear mainly as application areas; anticipates the EU AI regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: €2.22bn total investment over five years, €1.5bn public, with training taking over half
Massive AI training plan of €700M under France 2030 targeting 2000 undergraduates, 1500 masters students and 200 PhDs annually
Aim to capture 10-15% of the global embedded AI market by 2025
€80M public funding for trustworthy AI (Confiance.ai) on certification and safety, anticipating the EU AI regulation
Governance via a national AI coordinator and the SGPI, with public-private partnership
